title: Typography, Icons, Reading Assistance & Accessibility Runtime
objective: Implement the bounded UISK typography/icon/micro-identity runtime plus application-wide reading-assistance and accessibility-precedence behavior over the completed UISR-01/02 registry and presentation engines.

included: semantic typography-role resolution and readable interface/display separation
shared semantic icon treatment/container runtime without glyph-meaning forks
application-wide Focus Anchor reading assistance with off/gentle/strong behavior and canonical-text preservation
application-wide readable typeface override including OpenDyslexic when a provenance-approved asset is available
combined reading-assistance composition, locale/script safety and role exclusions
high-contrast, large-text, reduced-distraction and accessibility precedence over Skin Pack presentation
focused UISR-03 tests and cross-platform exact-head validation
excluded: motion/effects/atmosphere and shared component recipe runtime reserved for UISR-04
Skin Laboratory and specialized-surface bindings reserved for UISR-05
unverified font bundling or medical/clinical claims for reading aids
gameplay, permission, hidden-information, routing, validation, provenance or AI authority
scope.completion_gate: The shared UI runtime can apply strong semantic typography/icon presentation and both independent reading-assistance preferences across eligible text surfaces with deterministic accessibility precedence, canonical-text preservation and safe fallbacks.

selection_boundaries: UISR-03 is selected by verified UISR-02 closeout but has no implementation authority until a later owner Continue.
The ui-implementation lane remains parallel to product-development and may not pause or rewrite MCS work.
Publication to Multiversal-app main remains serialized by the existing merge lease and requires fresh-base reconciliation if another lane publishes first.
Exact production font asset/version/license/provenance must be verified before any readable-typeface asset is bundled.
next_action: No UISR-03 work remains. UISR-04 is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.

completion_evidence.governed_start_publication_note: The owner Continue granted live authority and the governed-start projection validated, but AIOC main publication was serialized behind a pre-existing product-lane AIOC lease. The same validated control-plane branch therefore carries final closeout rather than mutating or releasing the other lane's lease.
